stem.text: A wire is stretched by a gradually increasing force. The force–extension graph for the wire is shown.

stem.alt: Graph of force against extension for a wire, with points labelled P, Q, R and S on the curve

A.text: Point Q is the elastic limit.

B.text: Point R is the limit of proportionality.

C.text: The area under the graph from P to S is the elastic potential energy stored in the wire.

D.text: The area under the graph from P to S is the work done in stretching the wire.
